_about: 두고그룹 홈페이지 영상 — Seedance 2.0 샷 리스트. 11개 장면(스토리보드)을 한 번 생성해 메인 배경(26초)·전체 그룹 영상(45초)·사업별 루프 7개에 모두 사용합니다. assemble.sh 가 이 파일의 순서·길이로 편집합니다.

cost_estimate_credits.note: Higgsfield get_cost 기준(2026-10-13): 1080p std 9/초, 720p std 4.5/초, 720p fast 2.5/초

style: miniature 3D clay diorama world, soft warm daylight, tilt-shift depth of field, cream-white rounded buildings with large warm-lit windows, lush round trees and planters, pastel palette, gentle Pixar-like animation, smooth cinematic camera, no on-screen text, no subtitles, no logos added
mascot: a cute soft-clay light-blue mascot shaped like a rounded droplet, big glossy black oval eyes, small friendly smile, navy crossbody satchel with a tiny teal button, navy shoes (same character as the reference image)

shots.prompt: {mascot} stands on a rooftop terrace of the miniature town, looks up as a tiny warm glowing spark of an idea twinkles above its head, then smiles and waves happily. Slow gentle push-in. {style}

Camera glides toward the BIO NZ laboratory building. Inside the bright window, tiny researchers in white lab coats carefully examine green health-supplement bottles and test tubes; {mascot} peeks through the glass with curiosity, tilting its head. Calm, precise, clean mood. {style}

shots.narration: 생각은 제품이 되고, 제품은 브랜드가 됩니다.
shots.prompt: Inside the COMMERCE shop, simple plain products on a table transform into neatly designed branded packages lined up on a glowing display shelf; {mascot} places the last package and steps back proudly. Slow lateral dolly. {style}

Inside the MEDIA studio, a small cinema camera on a tripod and a soft ring light; a host speaks warmly to the camera while {mascot} behind the camera gives a cheerful thumbs-up; monitors glow softly. Slow push-in through the window. {style}

shots.narration: 경험을 나누면, 또 다른 시작이 태어납니다.
shots.prompt: Camera moves through the entrance of the CAMPUS building into a bright classroom: an instructor presents to attentive students at round tables; {mascot} sits in the front row taking notes, then raises its hand with excitement. Warm, hopeful mood. {style}

Inside the AD office, a wall of screens shows simple colorful bar charts that grow upward and a rising arrow line; {mascot} points at the rising graph and does a small happy hop. No readable text on screens. Slow push-in. {style}

At the FOOD market with a navy awning, crates of fresh colorful vegetables and fruit; a small white delivery van gently pulls up; {mascot} carries a crate of fresh produce with a big smile while customers sit at cafe tables. Gentle tracking shot. {style}

Inside the SPACE building, a bright coworking office with plants where people work at long desks; the light shifts to a warm evening glow as {mascot} relaxes on a soft sofa by the large window, content. Slow push-in. {style}

shots.narration: 하나의 생각이, 더 많은 가능성과 만났습니다.
shots.prompt: Camera slowly pulls back over the plaza; soft glowing blue light lines travel along the paths and connect all seven buildings into one network; {mascot} stands at the central plaza watching the lights link up. Magical but subtle. {style}

shots.narration: 사람과 브랜드, 그리고 일상이 이어지는 곳.
shots.prompt: Slow wide dolly across the lively plaza: people walk between the buildings, sit by the round planter, trees sway gently, a delivery van passes; {mascot} waves to passers-by. Warm golden-hour light. {style}

shots.narration: 좋은 사업이 더 나은 내일을 만듭니다.
shots.prompt: Smooth aerial pull-back revealing the whole miniature town of seven rounded buildings around the central plaza, people moving below, {mascot} waving from the rooftop terrace; ends on a calm wide establishing shot with open soft sky in the upper third for a logo overlay. {style}

hero_loop._about: 메인 첫 화면 배경(무음 반복). 구간 경계 시간은 index.html 히어로 장면 표시기의 data-start/data-end 와 같아야 합니다.

film._about: 그룹 영상 보기(45초) — S01~S11 전체 길이를 순서대로. 자막은 assets/video/group-film.ko.vtt
